facts.fact: According to Antenna's Adds & Ads report, ad plans drove 78% of net subscriber additions at premium SVOD services that offer an ad plan over the nine quarters to Q1 2026.
facts.quote: ad plans drove 78% of net subscriber additions over the nine quarters to Q1 2026, according to Antenna’s Adds & Ads report

facts.fact: Quantumrun, citing Antenna's Q1 2026 data, reports that overall premium SVOD growth slowed to 7% in 2025, down from 12% in 2024.
facts.quote: overall premium SVOD growth slowed to 7% in 2025, down from 12% in 2024

facts.fact: Antenna's Q2 2026 report counts more than 110 million US ad-supported streaming plans, excluding Amazon Prime Video.
facts.quote: US ad-supported streaming plans | More than 110M | Antenna, Q2 2026 report | Excludes Amazon Prime Video

facts.fact: According to Antenna, ad plans held 48% of subscriptions at premium SVOD services offering an ad plan as of March 2026, up 2 points year over year and 9 points over two years.
facts.quote: Ad plans’ share of subscriptions | 48%, up 2 points year over year and 9 points over two years

facts.fact: According to Antenna, ad plans accounted for 59% of gross additions at premium SVOD services offering an ad plan in Q1 2026.
facts.quote: Ad plans’ share of gross additions | 59%

facts.fact: According to Antenna, ad plans accounted for 78% of net additions (50.4M of 64.8M) at premium SVOD services offering an ad plan over the nine quarters to Q1 2026.
facts.quote: Ad plans’ share of net additions | 78% (50.4M of 64.8M)

facts.fact: According to Antenna's Q2 2026 report, 78% of premium SVOD subscribers have used an ad plan at some point in the past four years.
facts.quote: Premium SVOD subscribers who have used an ad plan | 78% | Antenna, Q2 2026 report | At some point in the past four years

facts.fact: According to Antenna's Q2 2026 data, US Specialty SVOD subscriptions reached 42 million, up 14% year over year, covering smaller paid services outside Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video and Hulu.
facts.quote: Specialty SVOD subscriptions | 42M, up 14% year over year | Antenna, Q2 2026

facts.fact: As of September 2026, Netflix's ad plan costs $8.99 a month, compared with $19.99 a month for its Standard ad-free plan, according to Fortune.
facts.quote: As of September 2026, Netflix’s ad plan cost $8.99 a month against $19.99 for its Standard ad-free plan

facts.fact: According to Fortune's September 2026 roundup, eight major services cost $139.41 a month without ads, or $89.92 a month using each service's standard ad-supported plan where one exists.
facts.quote: Fortune put eight major services at $139.41 a month without ads, or $89.92 using each service’s standard ad-supported plan where one exists.

facts.fact: According to Antenna's Adds & Ads report, 37% of subscribers who joined an ad plan were still subscribed after 12 months, compared with 39% of ad-free subscribers.
facts.quote: After 12 months, 37% of subscribers who joined an ad plan were still subscribed, compared with 39% of those who chose ad-free.

facts.fact: According to Antenna, within 90 days of cancelling pay TV without moving to a virtual pay TV service, 43% of cord cutters had an ad-supported premium SVOD plan.
facts.quote: within 90 days 43% had an ad-supported premium SVOD plan, 30% had only an ad-free plan and 27% had no premium SVOD at all

facts.fact: Within 90 days of cancelling pay TV, 30% of those cord cutters had only an ad-free premium SVOD plan, and 27% had no premium SVOD at all, per Antenna.
facts.quote: 43% had an ad-supported premium SVOD plan, 30% had only an ad-free plan and 27% had no premium SVOD at all

facts.quote: MoffettNathanson projected AVOD spending would rise 17% in 2025, to more than $15 billion across 11 streaming platforms

facts.quote: US CTV upfront ad spending ($17.73 billion) would exceed primetime linear TV upfront spending ($16.98 billion) in 2026 for the first time

facts.fact: CTAM's roundup lists Media Dynamics figures of $17.2 billion in streaming upfront dollars against $16.6 billion for linear TV.
facts.quote: CTAM’s roundup also lists Media Dynamics figures of $17.2 billion in streaming upfront dollars against $16.6 billion for linear.
